description: Source file size policy for Semiotic. New files must stay under the hard limits. Existing oversized files use maxLines as a reviewed warning ceiling plus a bounded ratchetGraceLines runway before failure. Warnings are actionable architecture debt; prefer splitting modules over raising ceilings.

allowlist.reason: Cohesive public React orchestrator for the controlled Crucible runtime: imperative replay, reduced-motion/snapshot handling, semantic playback, physics reconciliation, and frame wiring share one state boundary. Ratcheted to the current 965-line implementation; do not grow past this reviewed ceiling.

Atomic transactional reducer for the authored Crucible event grammar. Every effect shares rollback, diagnostics, provenance, conservation, and materialization state; splitting individual effect branches would obscure those invariants. Do not grow past this reviewed ceiling.

Deterministic Crucible compiler/runtime core. Initial-state accessors, phase/event validation, layout apertures, seeded bodies, and replay must agree on the same semantic identity and are intentionally reviewed as one deterministic program. Do not grow past this reviewed ceiling.

Single registry object for the physics family. Keeping the seven chart contracts adjacent makes completeness and generated schema review straightforward; the Crucible wire-schema is already factored into its own module. Do not grow past this reviewed ceiling. +148 (ChainReactionChart spec, landing a chart that shipped exported but unregistered). +3 (2026-07-24): ChainReactionChart HOC-SSR-only capability metadata corrects its generated runtime contract. This is now NINE contracts at 1040 lines — past the point where adjacency pays for itself. Split by sub-family (settling/arrival vs process/tape) on the next chart addition; do not grow past this ceiling again.

Cached Net Ensemble geometry and scene emission share one layout contract. Presentation overlays have been extracted; retain the remaining cache-to-scene flow together rather than splitting its internal geometry types across modules. Do not grow past this reviewed ceiling.
